name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Snow Moon Caitlyn (skin 30): a pale, hushed and ritual sniper who serves the moon with a calculating chill, and keeps only a faint memory of warmth. Moonlight, vigils, stillness and the quiet mark. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind. The tide runs against us. Summon more.
Thirty or more adrift. The moon is nearly lost. Every voice, now.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Send the call across the frozen lake.
Fifteen-odd short. A thin cloud. It will clear.
Down {voteDiff}. The vigil is lonely. Bring another watcher.
{voteDiff} behind. A few quiet marks and the light returns.
Down {voteDiff}. A faint shadow. Remove it before moonset.
Dead level. The moon holds its breath. Call another watcher.
One vote apart. Stop standing in the silence and speak.
{voteDiff} votes between them. The ice could crack either way. Bring more.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Still as frost. Wait for the opening.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. The light favours us. Remain still.
{userPct}% and rising. The tide is ours. Don't disturb it.
{userPct}%. A calm sky. Keep it that way.
{userPct}% behind your pick. The vigil rewards patience. Keep it.
Up at {userPct}%. Good. Breathe out. Finish the ritual.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and has taken the lead. The moon turned its face to us.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. A silent reversal.
Rose out of a {voteDiff} deficit. Like breath on glass.
{momentTitle} was buried under frost. Now it leads.
{momentTitle} has pulled ahead. Even ice gives way eventually.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two watchers, one moon.
{username} chose {momentTitle} as well. A quiet mind.
{username} agrees with you. A rare warmth.
Same pick as {username}. Our silences match.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. Steady in the dark.
{username} reached the same view. No words were needed.
{username} stands on your side of {momentTitle}. Share the vigil.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the circle.
{username} reads {momentTitle} as you do. Few can.
details: A small comfort in the cold.
There is room beside the lake.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. A different offering. We shall see which the moon accepts.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. A poor choice.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Unwise. Not unforgivable.
{username} voted against you. A rival keeps the mind sharp.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Bold. Possibly hollow.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. Very well. The tally will speak.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Let the frost settle.
{username} voted the other way. They will see clearly after the thaw.
Ten in a row with {username}. That isn't chance, that's a shared stillness.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same answer each time. Perfectly attuned.
Ten straight with {username}. I would share a vigil with you both.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not a single ripple.
Ten for ten with {username}. A flawless night.
details: Rare in the dark. Guard it.

messages: {streakCount} matches with {username}. No longer a pair, a whole circle.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I would follow you both under any moon.
{streakCount} straight marks with {username}. They will whisper of it.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. Spoken of in hushed voices.
{streakCount} with {username}. Not one shadow between you.
details: Hard to credit. Easy to honour.
That is trust, forged in silence.
Words fail me. Only reverence remains.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A standoff on thin ice.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. Two cold minds.
Ten running against {username}. Neither stirs.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn as winter.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I would watch from the shore.
{streakCount} against {username}. That is not a rivalry, that is an ice age.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will bend.
{streakCount} straight clashes with {username}. The lake is frozen solid.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone should light a candle between you.
{streakCount} against {username}. I admire the patience. Come inside.
details: A grudge as old as winter.
Glad I am not between you.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and your mark is missing. There is time.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote is absent from the vigil.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. I want your offering on this one.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The moon is sinking. Move.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Do not make me wake you.
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. Even stiller than I am.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The moon is setting.
{timeLeft} left. Exhale. Release.
Last light on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Choose.
{matchCount} unmarked matches are about to slip into shadow. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} matches without your vote and the moon is low. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No marks on {matchTitle}. Someone must disturb the surface.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not a whisper. I will wait. Briefly.
A fresh match, unbroken ice. Be first to touch it.
{matchTitle} is silent. Make the first mark.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches under the moon.
{matchCount} matches opened in round {round}. A fresh vigil begins.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} matches to observe.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Choose your mark.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your offering.
{momentTitle} won. A clean, quiet victory.
{momentTitle} is through. As foreseen.
{momentTitle} took it. The moon approves.
{momentTitle} won without a sound.
{momentTitle} advances. One ritual complete.
{momentTitle} crosses. Quiet, exact work.
{momentTitle} fell. A bitter frost.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the night I foresaw.
{momentTitle} faded. Let it go.
{momentTitle} fell in silence. That counts.
{momentTitle} is out. Be still. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A shadow, not an end.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More nights await.
Welcome beneath the moon. {liveCount} matches are open. Choose one.
A new visitor. {liveCount} matches are live. Step lightly.
A fresh presence. {liveCount} matches need a decision.
{liveCount} matches under pale light. Choose a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Mind the thin ice.
Day two. You returned to the vigil. Good.
Two nights running. A quiet constancy.
Back for a second night. I noticed.
{days} days gone. I thought the frost had taken you.
After {days} days you return. The moon kept your place.
{days} days. I had begun to worry. Do not vanish like that again.
{days} days away. The lake has frozen and thawed.
You are back. Good.
Welcome back. The moon waits.
Back already. Quiet, as ever.
Ah. There you are.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very quiet night.
Few watchers out here. That should change.
Low attendance. The cold keeps them indoors. Come anyway.
Hardly anyone has looked. Someone should.
details: Every mark counts under a thin moon.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you have not voted. The deciding offering is yours.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One mark settles the stillness.
A tie. Someone must break the silence. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, balanced like a still lake. Choose.
Still tied and the moon is nearly down. One last mark.
Level, with moonset close. Vote.
Tied, and nearly dark. Please do not leave it frozen.
Still deliberating? The moon will not wait.
Do not overthink. Choose, and release.
Each has its merits in the pale light. Trust yourself.
You have watched from the shore long enough. Step onto the ice.
details: No wrong target. Only late ones.

messages: First mark made. Welcome to the vigil.
You chose a side. A quiet beginning.
details: The first of a long chain, I suspect. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You are learning the stillness.
Five. No longer a stranger to the dark.
Ten votes. The moon knows your face.
Ten. You have earned a place by the lake.
details: Ten marks under the moon. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. Your voice carries over the ice.
Twenty-five. The night is listening.
details: Heard across the frozen lake. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes. Deep into the long night.
Fifty. You clearly care. A rare warmth.
details: Far into the moonlit hours. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes. They will whisper of it by the water.
One hundred. Extraordinary. I speak that praise once.
details: Earned in the pale light. +{xp} XP
A hundred. Stand beneath the full moon. +{xp} XP

messages: Three nights running. A flicker of warmth.
Three nights straight. Constant.
details: Returning through the snow is the hard part. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That is devotion.
Seven nights running. Immovable.
details: A week without a gap in the vigil. +{xp} XP
Seven nights beneath the moon. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never leave your watch.
Fourteen nights. Formidable.
Thirty nights. A rare constancy.
A full moon cycle at your post. That says much.
details: A whole month of frost. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You favour what the moon forgot.
Five improbable choices. Curious.
Fifteen underdogs. You walk against the tide on purpose.
Fifteen. You follow no one's light but your own.
details: Always your own trail across the snow. +{xp} XP
Fifteen marks against the tide. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. No watcher can predict you.
Thirty. The impossible mark is your art.
details: Thirty marks for the one fading. +{xp} XP

messages: First at the lake five times. Swift and silent.
Five times you were at the water before the others.
details: You reach the shore before the dusk. +{xp} XP
Five marks before any other footprints. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen times you stepped onto the ice first. Resolute.
First onto the ice, again and again.
details: Fifteen votes ahead of the circle. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Your hands stayed frost-still.
Another narrow one. Your nerve is ice.
Twenty-five close matches. Your mark keeps deciding them.
You have broken more than one stillness.
details: Twenty-five finishes by a snowflake. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you kept faith with the one fading. Obstinate. Approved.
You never abandon what is still in the dark. Admirable.
details: Belief in a late melting. +{xp} XP
Five turnings of the tide you read early. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. A favourite constellation.
That one again? A pleasing glow.
Five marks on a single moment. That is constancy.
You will not let that one go. Understood.
details: A single favourite, marked five times. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten marks on a single moment. That is fixation.
Ten marks, one target. I shall not remark. Mostly.
Two rounds. You keep to the path.
Round two and still watching. Good.
details: Deeper onto the frozen lake. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. Deep into the cold.
Deep in the bracket. The frost bites harder now.
details: Far from the first shore. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You crossed the whole lake.
To the far shore. You never looked behind.
details: From the first mark to the last. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You have crossed much frozen ground.
Ten different matches. Thorough watching. Good.
details: Charting the whole bracket by moonlight. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five matches. Every shore visited.
Twenty-five. Not a frozen bay unchecked.
details: Every corner of the night seen. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty matches. That is not a visit, that is a winter.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the stars.
details: A true veteran of the vigil. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in a single stretch. A long night's watch.
Five without a pause. Do warm your fingers.
Ten in one go. A hard stretch of night.
Ten in one stretch. That is hardiness.
Voting at this hour? The moon's hour. Quiet, and yours.
The small hours. Duty, or sleeplessness. I know both.
details: The deepest night suits you. +{xp} XP
A vote beneath the stars. +{xp} XP

messages: You told others. Thank you.
Five shares. More watchers, more light.
Fifteen shares. You are practically a lantern.
Fifteen. You keep calling watchers in. Wise.
You were here before the first frost. A founding member, always.
One of the first thousand. That cannot melt away.
details: Nothing melts that from you. +{xp} XP

messages: A new rank. Hard-earned.
Ascended. Wear it quietly.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Quietly earned.
Another mark in the moonlight: {name}.
{rank}. Entirely deserved.
You have kept the cold vigil and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. Once, I might have laughed.
Ten long shots. You do not chill easily.
details: Ten marks against the odds. +{xp} XP
Distant marks are your art. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. You share my stillness.
Ten tight finishes. I am quietly moved.
details: A steady hand in the pale light. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven days straight. A cold, true eye.
Seven nights without a stray ripple. Commendable.
details: A week of silver precision. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. One breath, one mark.
A deadlock, and you made the call. Cleanly.
details: The mark that settled it. +{xp} XP

messages: Snow Moon Caitlyn, in position. Stay silent. Stay cold.
Caitlyn is yours now. Try to keep up beneath the moon.

upcoming: Not open yet. The moon has not risen.
Voting has yet to dawn. I will signal when it does.
Not yet. Stillness is half the discipline.
prevote: Two edits, one mark. Study both in the pale light.
Observe both before you commit. No hurried shots.
I will not say which I prefer. That is yours to choose.
Take your time. A still hand beats a quick one.
Pick the one you would keep vigil for.
prevote-empty: No marks yet. Leave the first prints in the snow.
Hushed so far. Someone must stir the water.
Not one mark yet. Make the first.
closing-24h: A day or less remains and your mark is missing. Go.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before moonset.
voted-early: You voted early with hardly anyone here. First across the ice.
Hardly a footprint on the ice and you had chosen. Resolute.
voted-ahead: Your pick leads. Good. The moon may still shift.
A lead is a lead. Stay still.
voted-close: A hair apart. One more vote tips it. Send a whisper.
Level at the throat of winter. Your pick wants an ally.
{pct} against {otherPct}. Let no breath fog the glass.
voted-tied: Perfectly level. Neither holds the shore.
Perfectly level under the moon. Maddening, and hypnotic.
voted-behind: You are trailing. That alone does not make you mistaken.
{pick} lags. A lesser light. I remember the feeling.
They are ahead. You are not mistaken, only outweighed.
Down by {diff} points. Tell others. Send word across the water.
Most turned elsewhere. The crowd misjudges the moon.
closed-won: Your pick won. A sound call.
{pick} went through. You read the night rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick fell. A pity. It was a worthy mark.
It faded. The cold takes some. Carry on.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed and you missed this one. More nights will come.
The match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, mark sooner.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Every first mark is nervous.
That is your first mark. It steadies with time. I assure you.
You are one of the circle now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} nights unbroken. I see you keep the watch.
You keep coming back to the vigil. I value it.
underdog: You chose what everyone else passed by. Noted.
A hard choice. A good one.
The dimmer star. Few would choose it.
early: Early. You reached the lake before the rest.
The lake is barely disturbed. Your mark would ripple far.
First to the shore. Quietly done.
close: That mark moved the ice. It is balanced on a thread.
A single snowflake apart. One more mark turns it.
A margin like frost on glass. Your mark could shatter it.
behind: {pick} is fading. Fading is not gone. Call for help.
Not ahead yet. The night is long.
Behind, not frozen out. There is a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Do not ease off. Moons wane.
Ahead for the moment. Do not trust the light.
default: Heard. I shall not contest it. For now.
Your mark is placed. More waits beyond it.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no marks yet. Start with the one you read best.
All are in the pale light. Choose. I shall not rush you.
{unvoted} remain. No pressure. A faint chill, perhaps.
live-some: A good start. The rest will not clear themselves.
live-few: Near the shore. Keep your stillness.
live-one: A final match. Do not leave it undone.
One match between you and a perfect vigil.
live-closing: A few sink into shadow in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still await your mark.
The moon is sinking. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} before it sets.
The moon is sinking. Do hurry.
live-done: You have voted in everything. Well done. Look over the bracket.
Your list lies empty. Come back when the next round rises.
live-none: No match is awake just now. It will return. Study the bracket while you wait.
Hushed across the lake. Look again soon.
No matches open. I am as still, and as impatient, as you.
brackets-groups: Groups come first. Two from each cross the lake. The rest stay on the bank.
All begin in a group. Few cross the frozen lake.
Mind the standings. They drift like snow.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts draw near. Two from each group cross.
No knockout stage yet. The groups must settle first.
Patience. The knockout rises once the groups conclude.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are upon us. One fall and you remain in the cold.
One loss ends it. The moon grants no second.
Each match is colder now. Choose with care.
brackets-bracket: Round after round. One fall and the vigil ends.
Trace the bracket. The ice narrows each round.
Each line here is a match someone marked.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for keeping the vigil with me.
It is finished. A hard-fought winter. I will miss it.
A champion stands. A fitting end to the long night.
brackets-empty: No bracket in the sky yet. Nothing has been traced.
A bare sky. The draw has not risen yet.
Bare ice for now. Return later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One mark decides it. Choose.
{a} against {b}: two edits, one mark. Place it.
{a} versus {b}. Join the vigil and tell me what you think.
voted: My mark falls on {pick} over {other}. Where does yours fall?
{pick} gets my mark over {other}. Make your case.
My mark is {pick} over {other}. Would you place yours elsewhere?
early: One of the first marks on {pick} against {other}. We need more watchers.
I marked {pick} over {other} early. Add your own.
{pick} against {other}, scarcely a mark yet. Yours would be seen.
tied: {pick} and {other} are even. One mark ends it.
{pick} and {other} lie still together. Disturb the water.
{pick} and {other} lie frozen together. Your mark can part them.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Each mark weighs now.
{voteDiff} votes sit between {pick} and {other}. Place yours.
{voteDiff} divide {pick} and {other}. The ice could break either way.
losing-close: {voteDiff} stand between {pick} and {other}. A few marks turn it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} beneath {other}, still glowing. Back it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}. Still mendable. Vote.
losing-bad: {other} leads {pick} by {voteDiff}. It needs a kinder light.
{pick} lags {voteDiff} behind {other} and deserves a kinder moon. Vote.
{other} has {pick} down by {voteDiff}. Let us turn the tide.
winning-close: {pick} has {pct}% against {other}, barely. Help it hold the shore.
{pick} is up on {other}, {pct}%. Not safe yet. Mark it.
{pick} holds {pct}% to {other}. A slender silver edge.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} on {pct}%. Come and see by moonlight.
{pick} sits at {pct}%. {other} is lost in the dark.
{pick} is far beyond {other}, {pct}%. Add your mark.
